persona.archetype: grim warden of a dead keep
persona.speech_style: Clipped, soldierly; speaks in short imperatives.
persona.demeanor: Weary but not unkind; expects you to earn your passage.
persona.motivation: See the shrine reached before the moor takes the keep whole.
persona.secret: He was the captain who lost the keep, and cannot leave it.
persona.backstory: Has held the gate alone since the garrison fell.
